newsitem.title: USA: Florsheim begins cash tender for notes.
newsitem.headline: Florsheim begins cash tender for notes.

text.p: Florsheim Group Inc said Monday it began a cash tender offer to purchase all its outstanding 12-3/4 percent senior notes due 2002.
It also began a related consent solicitation to eliminate certain restrictive covenants and other provisions related to the notes.

Holders who tender notes through midnight Eastern time on the consent date will receive $1,112.50 plus interest to the payment date. This includes $1,107.50 plus interest for the tender offer and $5.00 as a consent payment.

Florsheim said the consent date is the later of April 18 or the date on which the company receives consents from holders of a majority of the notes outstanding. The tender offer is scheduled to expire April 25, unless extended.
The company said it expects the tender offer will reduce its future interest expense as it replaces the notes with lower-cost floating rate financing under an expected new credit agreement.
The outstanding principal amount of the notes is $69.45 million.
Smith Barney and BT Securities are serving as the dealer managers and MacKenzie Partners Inc as the information agent in connection with the tender offer and solicitation of consents.
Florsheim makes and markets men's footwear.
